_note: Hand-grade of sft-v7-suggest on the 40 real commits, 1 Sep 2026. One grader.

_classes.contradicted: the diff visibly shows the opposite of what the finding asserts
_classes.no-such-entity: names an identifier, operator or value absent from the diff
_classes.incoherent: a defect claimed against a pure addition, which has no prior behaviour
_classes.inverted: the commit IS the fix; the model reads the repair as the defect
_classes.partial: locus right, mechanism imprecise or unproven
